avis.texte: First of all, I have an oily combination skin that could be rather sensitive depending on my cycle. I have about 10-15 toners at any given date so that I can pick and use the toner to fit my particular focus at the time (peeling, extra cleaning, soothing, hydraing, calming, etc..). So for this one, I am using it as the 1st or 2nd step toner to use after washing my face. (after peeling or extra cleansing toner but before hydrating skin). I liked that it doesn’t have any discernible, overpowering fragrance as I am so sensitive to smell and never like scented skin care products. So that was a good first impression as soon as I opened the bottle. Now I feel this toner leaves you a smooth kind of creamy (?) skin afterwards. Not sure my picture can show you that, but it was taken 10 secs after wiping my hands with toner twice. To test hydration, I didn’t put anything else after wiping my face with this toner for about 30 mins, and I didn’t feel too much dryness except around my lips (which is my usual dry area). But of course, I would recommend you follow skin/lotion/cream routines. When I tested this toner, my skin was going through a sensitive period, but it didn’t irritate me at all. Still, not sure how it would workout for much drier skin but it is such a great first step toner for all skin types in my opinion. Overall, considering cost vs benefits, this toner is one of better toners compared to ones around $ 10-15 for the same size for sure. In that, it is a well balanced prod

avis.titre: watery texture, contains lotus water & extracts, hyaluronic acid, made in Korea
avis.texte: This Rovectin Clean Lotus Water Calming toner comes in a transparent, colorless plastic bottle, and the toner itself also colorless and transparent, with a consistency like water. It absorbs almost instantly. It is dispensed by shaking it out of an opening. It is a hydrating, non-astringent toner, meant to be used as a first light layer of hydration before applying serums and creams. The main ingredient is lotus water and lotus extracts, which have lots of antioxidants and have a soothing effect on skin. It also contains several types of sodium hyaluronate for moisture retention. Juniperus Mexicana oil (aka Texas cedarwood) is also in the ingredients list. Botanical essential oils typically have fragrant floral compounds, and those can potentially irritate sensitive skin. However, the scent is mild to undetectable in this toner, so if you have sensitive skin, this may not irritate it. Patch testing is always recommended to be sure, though, if you have easily irritated skin and are trying out or introducing a product into your skincare routine. It's made in Korea. The bottom of the bottle is clearly marked with the expiration date, and the full ingredients are printed in both English and Korean on the bottle. The ingredients are: Nelumbo Nucifera Flower Water(392,000ppm), Water, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Propanediol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Betaine, Nelumbium Speciosum Flower Extract, Nelumbo Nucifera Leaf Extract, Nelumbo Nucifera Root Extract, Glyceryl Glucoside, Xylitylglucoside,

avis.titre: Best hydrating toner on the market
avis.texte: I’ve used so many hydrating toners and essences over the past ten years and this is quite honestly the best I’ve ever tried. It’s incredibly light, and absorbs quickly leaving behind beautiful hydrated skin with no film. It’s very calming and makes any moisturizer you put over it even more hydrating. Highly recommend.

This is a toner I wasn't sure if it made my skin better but it moisturized !!! Very watery and easy to for the skin to absorb. I personally don't mind a little "film" feel because I'm going to put moisturizer on top of it but to each their own. It didn't cause any breakouts and my skin reacted positively to it when I'd apply it. Overall good product and intention, no scent and lasts a long time because you don't need much if you apply with your hands.
Fragrance free, sensitive, hydrating, a banging product. Will buy again!
